generatedCommentsNodes.comment: Inconsistent implementation of the TEXT→KEYWORD conversion across the four aggregate functions. `Max` uses the new `noText()` helper (`field().dataType().noText()`), while `Min`, `Top`, and `Values` each inline the same logic as a ternary (`t == TEXT ? KEYWORD : t`). Since the `noText()` method was introduced precisely to centralize this conversion, all four should use it for consistency and to avoid the inline check being forgotten or diverging in future edits.

Removing `entry(TEXT, ToString::new)` from the converter map eliminates `TO_TEXT()` / `CAST(x AS TEXT)` as a valid operation entirely. The capability comment (#XT9H6) states "All functions that take TEXT should never emit TEXT, only KEYWORD," which is about function *return* types. However, this change goes further and removes TEXT as a valid *cast target*, meaning users can no longer explicitly produce a TEXT-typed value. If the intent is only to prevent functions from *returning* TEXT while still allowing explicit casts, this removal may be too broad. If the intent is to fully deprecate TEXT as an output type, consider whether a deprecation warning or migration path should be provided rather than a hard removal.

review_comment: If we're already adding the .noText() to the test cases (like MaxTests), why are we adding it here too?

This is the comprehensive 'catch all' case we added late in the PR once we had covered all the low hanging fruit. But perhaps this means we can remove some of the other earlier code. I'll investigate.

Indeed there were 12 places we had added this `noText()` that no longer needed it, since they all called into this TestCase constructor. I've removed them all and will push a commit after re-running tests to be safe.
Yes! I was busy creating a new issue for that, but glad to see you already did, way back! I'll add a 'fixes' line to the PR description.
